source: LLM second-key check over the tweak build's context_fill + grammar_form banks; verdicts are Layer-C review flags, needs_review: true

flagged.filled_sentence: 右のページをめくる。
flagged.why: Turning the right-hand page of a book is natural; second key.

flagged.filled_sentence: デパートで大学のカレンダーを買いました。
flagged.why: A university-branded calendar is a grammatical, plausible purchase; possible second key.

flagged.filled_sentence: 何人もの人がそこにいた。
flagged.why: 何人もの人 ('many people') is a fully natural idiom; second key.

flagged.filled_sentence: 父にいくらかけたの？
flagged.why: お金をかける on a person (gift/care for father) is natural; possible second key.

flagged.filled_sentence: なんかいい駅じゃない。
flagged.why: 'Nice station, isn't it' is natural; 道 (いい道じゃない) also works; second key.

flagged.filled_sentence: 口をつけようじゃないか。
flagged.why: 口をつける (take a sip/taste) is a real idiom; the sentence is grammatical and plausible.

flagged.filled_sentence: 一年前くらい前に来ました。
flagged.why: Key itself unnatural: 前 is duplicated (一年前くらい前); source sentence is defective.

flagged.filled_sentence: 何で後ろに行かないといけないの？
flagged.why: 'Why do I have to go to the back?' is fully natural; second key.

flagged.filled_sentence: 男は毎日うちにいます。
flagged.why: 'The man is at home every day' is grammatical and natural; second key.

flagged.filled_sentence: あした 花を かう
flagged.why: Buying flowers tomorrow is natural (木をかう also plausible); second key.

flagged.filled_sentence: ノートに３日が書いてある
flagged.why: A date written in a notebook is plausible (６日 likewise); possible second key.

flagged.filled_sentence: かばんの中にペンが五つある
flagged.why: Key unnatural: pens take the 本 counter (五本); つ-counting pens is non-standard teaching Japanese.

flagged.filled_sentence: もう一人たちました
flagged.why: Stem uses kana たちました, so もう一人立ちました ('one more person stood up') is natural; second key.

flagged.filled_sentence: 何時に友だちと会います
flagged.why: With no closing punctuation, 何時に友だちと会います(？) reads as a natural question; possible second key.

flagged.filled_sentence: テーブルの下にコップが四つあります
flagged.why: Under the table (and 右, to the right) is fully natural; second key.

flagged.filled_sentence: 右にも電車が来る
flagged.why: Natural at a station with two tracks: 'a train is also coming on the right'. 南 (南にも電車が来る, 'trains run in the south too') is marginal too.

flagged.filled_sentence: 大学は何もしたくない
flagged.why: Grammatical as a contrastive topic ('as for college, I don't want to do anything'). A little odd, but strict rule: in doubt, flag.

flagged.filled_sentence: めったに来ない車だ
flagged.why: Natural: 'it's a car (e.g. bus or rare model) that hardly ever comes by'. 母 also works: めったに来ない母だ, 'a mother who rarely visits'.

flagged.filled_sentence: まえにワインがありますか。
flagged.why: Borderline: read as 前に, it can mean 'is there wine up front / at the front (of the store or shelf)?'. That is spatial 前に rather than the target grammar, but it forms a usable sentence.

flagged.filled_sentence: 右のページをめくる。
flagged.why: right-hand page of a book: natural, correct

flagged.filled_sentence: 運転の仕方は、森が教えてくれたんだ。
flagged.why: 森 read as surname (Mori): 'Mori taught me how to drive' is natural

flagged.filled_sentence: 世に真の大事なし。
flagged.why: key suspect: 世に真の大事なし is an obscure pseudo-classical aphorism; 真の大事 is not a natural collocation

flagged.filled_sentence: 小鳥たちが森の木でさえずっていた。
flagged.why: birds singing in the forest's trees: natural, correct

flagged.filled_sentence: ９日からオーバーを着てもかまいません。
flagged.why: 'from the 9th you may wear an overcoat' (dress-code date): natural

flagged.filled_sentence: 青空を見たくなったら、運動に行きます。
flagged.why: 運動に行く is a standard phrase; 'when I want to see the blue sky I go out to exercise' is natural

flagged.filled_sentence: 建物でエスカレーターがありません。
flagged.why: key suspect: 建物でエスカレーターがありません is awkward; existence with ある takes に/には, and the stem lacks この

flagged.filled_sentence: 男はデパートでオーバーをあつらえた。
flagged.why: 'the man had an overcoat tailored at the department store': natural narrative

flagged.filled_sentence: そっちはもう暗いの？こっちはまだ火曜日よ。
flagged.why: time-zone reading: 'Is it already dark there? Here it is still Tuesday' is natural

flagged.filled_sentence: 着物のしたにセーターを着た方がよい。
flagged.why: wearing a sweater under a kimono for warmth: grammatical and plausible advice

flagged.filled_sentence: 教える子どもでもその名前を知っている。
flagged.why: relative clause: 'even the children (I) teach know that name' is natural

flagged.filled_sentence: お金持ちは今朝からずっと車を洗っている。
flagged.why: 'the rich man has been washing his car since this morning': grammatical, coherent

flagged.filled_sentence: その語にはいくつかの注意がある。
flagged.why: 'there are several caveats about that word' (usage notes): acceptable, borderline

flagged.filled_sentence: １日でどれくらいホットドッグを運ぶんですか？
flagged.why: 'how many hot dogs do you deliver/carry per day?' is natural

flagged.filled_sentence: あいつ、ほんと口が立つからな。
flagged.why: 口が立つ is an idiom (eloquent/glib): 'that guy is really a smooth talker' is natural

flagged.filled_sentence: あの家ではノートを売っていますか？
flagged.why: あの家では～を売っている is natural for a family-run shop/household; valid second key.

flagged.filled_sentence: お兄さんはいつもパンを食べます。
flagged.why: Topic slot accepts any person; 'Older brother always eats bread' is fully natural (お金持ち also grammatical).

flagged.filled_sentence: 北さんは元気？
flagged.why: 北 (Kita) is a real surname; 北さんは元気？ is a natural sentence.

flagged.filled_sentence: おじは食堂の近くに住んでいる。
flagged.why: Any place noun fits の近くに住んでいる; 'My uncle lives near the cafeteria/diner' is natural.

flagged.filled_sentence: 米はもう上がっている。
flagged.why: Natural as 'rice (price) has already gone up' (米が上がる = price rise, common colloquially).

flagged.filled_sentence: まちがっているのは月だ。
flagged.why: Natural when checking a date: 'the one that's wrong is the month'.

flagged.filled_sentence: 自分お金貸してもらえない？
flagged.why: Kansai 自分 = 'you' makes this a natural request; 帰り (帰り、お金貸してもらえない？ 'on the way back') is also plausible in casual particle-dropping speech.

flagged.filled_sentence: 兄に言うべきことなのだろうか？
flagged.why: Fully natural: 'Is it something I should tell my older brother?' Same frame as the key 母.

flagged.filled_sentence: もうこれよりほかに薬はない。
flagged.why: Natural: 'There is no other medicine besides this one anymore.'

flagged.filled_sentence: 昼ご飯は工場で作られる。
flagged.why: Grammatical and plausible (factory-made bento / central-kitchen school lunches); borderline, flagged per strictness.

flagged.filled_sentence: 少女はそんな人なことは聞いたこともないと言った。
flagged.why: Key itself is ungrammatical: そんな人なこと (noun 人 + な) is not valid Japanese; the Tatoeba source sentence carries the error (should be e.g. そんな人のこと). Drop or repair the sentence.

flagged.filled_sentence: 外国でやるしかないよ。
flagged.why: Natural: 'We have no choice but to do it abroad.'

flagged.filled_sentence: 急行であるように見えた。
flagged.why: Grammatical with an omitted subject: '(The train) appeared to be an express.'

flagged.filled_sentence: 高校であったように見える。
flagged.why: Natural with omitted subject: '(The building) looks like it used to be a high school.' 映画 is also marginally possible.

flagged.filled_sentence: 明日、屋上でもどう？
flagged.why: Natural as proposing a place: 'How about (meeting on) the rooftop tomorrow?'

flagged.filled_sentence: 家がよく見えません。
flagged.why: Natural: 'I can't see the house well.' 池 (池がよく見えません) is equally natural.

flagged.filled_sentence: 日曜日ってすぐに終わってしまうんです。
flagged.why: Natural: 'Sundays end so quickly.' １０日 is also plausible ('ten days go by fast').

flagged.filled_sentence: あの姉は一体どうなってしまうのかしら。
flagged.why: Plausible: emotional あの + own sister ('what on earth will become of that sister of mine?').

flagged.filled_sentence: 声がどんどん強くなった。
flagged.why: Natural: 'The voice(s) grew stronger and stronger.'

flagged.filled_sentence: 別にしなくていいんですよ。
flagged.why: Natural: 'You don't need to keep it separate.' (別にする = separate).

flagged.filled_sentence: 店に入れられると思いますよ。
flagged.why: Grammatical and natural: 'I think it can be put into the store / you can stock it in the shop.' 門 is marginally possible too.

flagged.filled_sentence: 女はとうとうタバコをやめた。
flagged.why: Natural narrative sentence: 'The woman finally quit smoking.'

flagged.filled_sentence: その方はとうとう立ち去った。
flagged.why: Natural: その方 = 'that person (polite)'; 'That person finally left.'

flagged.filled_sentence: とうとう私たちは店が買えます。
flagged.why: Natural: 'At last we can buy a shop.'

flagged.filled_sentence: なるべく早く飲むよ。
flagged.why: Natural: 'I'll drink it as soon as I can.'

flagged.filled_sentence: ちょうど知らせるところだ。
flagged.why: Natural: 'I was just about to let you know.' 引き出す ('just about to withdraw (money)') is also plausible.

flagged.filled_sentence: 川ってそういうものだ。
flagged.why: Grammatical generic statement: 'That's just how rivers are.' Borderline, flagged per strictness.

flagged.filled_sentence: そういう紙もあったな。
flagged.why: Natural: 'Oh right, there was that kind of paper too.'

flagged.filled_sentence: 大学生みたいにメソメソするのはやめろ。
flagged.why: Grammatical and plausible comparison ('stop whining like a college student'); nothing in the stem rules out a person noun other than 女の子.

flagged.filled_sentence: ぼくは洋服がいる。
flagged.why: 'I need clothes' is fully natural; any needed noun fits Xがいる.

flagged.filled_sentence: リムジンを貸すといいですよ。
flagged.why: 'You should lend (out) the limousine' is grammatical and natural advice; 貸す is a same-slot transitive verb.

flagged.filled_sentence: 前方に働く車が見える。
flagged.why: 働く車 is an established phrase (work/service vehicles); 'I can see working vehicles ahead' is acceptable.

flagged.filled_sentence: ちょっと１日かかるかも。
flagged.why: Bare duration + かかる matches the particle-less slot; 'it might take a day or so' is borderline-acceptable colloquially (strict flag).

flagged.filled_sentence: 高校よりずっといいよ。
flagged.why: Context-free comparison stem; 'much better than high school' (also 今週よりずっといいよ) is perfectly natural.

flagged.filled_sentence: 漢字はだいたい終わった。
flagged.why: 'I've mostly finished the kanji (study/homework)' is natural.

flagged.filled_sentence: だいたい８時に森に着きます。
flagged.why: 'We arrive at the forest around 8' is grammatical and natural (e.g. hike itinerary).

flagged.filled_sentence: もっと早く見せるべきだった。
flagged.why: 'I should have shown it sooner' is fully natural.

flagged.filled_sentence: 始める前に今月の計画を立てなさい。
flagged.why: 'Make this month's plan before starting' is natural; ３日の計画 is also plausible.

flagged.filled_sentence: それでは、さっそく食べることにしましょう。
flagged.why: 'Well then, let's eat right away' is fully natural.

flagged.filled_sentence: 森に帰りなさいと言ったはずです。
flagged.why: 'I told you to go back to the forest' is grammatical and natural in context (e.g. to an animal); strict flag.

flagged.filled_sentence: その研究室がそんなことをしたはずがない。
flagged.why: An organization as agent: 'that lab can't have done such a thing' is natural.

flagged.filled_sentence: 特別かどうかはあなたしだいです。
flagged.why: 'Whether it's special is up to you' is natural; 強いかどうか also plausible.

flagged.filled_sentence: 始めるかどうかどうでもいいって！
flagged.why: 'I don't care whether you start or not!' is natural; 止める works the same way.

flagged.filled_sentence: 女にできるかどうか分からないよ。
flagged.why: 'I don't know if a woman can do it' is grammatical and natural (Xにできる with a person noun).

flagged.filled_sentence: それらはみんな漢字かい？
flagged.why: 'Are those all kanji?' is fully natural.

flagged.filled_sentence: やがて赤になるかもしれない。
flagged.why: 'It may soon turn red' (traffic light, leaves) is natural.

flagged.filled_sentence: 名前はもう聞かないよ。
flagged.why: 'I won't ask your name anymore' is natural.

flagged.filled_sentence: 話すことと知ることは別物だ。
flagged.why: 'Speaking and knowing are different things' is natural.

flagged.filled_sentence: 私はやっと聞くことができる。
flagged.why: 'I can finally ask/hear (it)' is natural; 貸す also grammatical.

flagged.filled_sentence: なら電話します。
flagged.why: Sentence-initial なら as a conjunction ('In that case, I'll call') is accepted in colloquial speech; strict flag.

flagged.filled_sentence: 私もそんな気なくて。
flagged.why: Casual particle-dropped 'そんな気(は)なくて。' (I didn't mean it that way either / didn't feel like it) is a natural colloquial utterance; second key.

flagged.filled_sentence: 一人で行くみたいな。
flagged.why: Sentence-final hedging 'みたいな。' is common colloquial speech ('like, going alone'); a native would accept it as a casual utterance.

flagged.filled_sentence: 私は花が好きで、たとえばばらが好きだ。
flagged.why: Key itself is marginal: 'たとえば' introducing a single liked item reads awkward; natives would say 特に/中でも. Distractors are all ungrammatical, but key naturalness is doubtful.

flagged.filled_sentence: これは本物のダイヤであるではないか。
flagged.why: Plain-form + ではないか is productive (来るではないか); 'であるではないか' is attested in written/rhetorical style ('Why, this is a real diamond!'). Awkward but arguably grammatical -> doubtful second key (opposite meaning).

flagged.filled_sentence: 少し音楽をかけていい後で？
flagged.why: Spoken afterthought inversion (かけていい、後で？ = 'can I put on some music later?') is natural casual speech; まず yields the same pattern (かけていい、まず？).

flagged.filled_sentence: 私たちはいつそこのたどり着くことになるだろうか。
flagged.why: Key sentence is ungrammatical: stem has typo 'そこの' where 'そこに' is required (そこにたどり着く). Stem must be fixed.

flagged.filled_sentence: お茶ぜひいかがでしょう。
flagged.why: Particle-dropped お茶 is normal (お茶いかがですか); 'お茶、ぜひいかがでしょう' is natural offer/sales phrasing -> second key.

flagged.filled_sentence: 試験後でなければいいのになあ。
flagged.why: String parses as 試験後(しけんご) + でなければ: 'I wish it weren't after the exam' (e.g. of an event's timing). Grammatical with context -> doubtful second key.

flagged.filled_sentence: 来週の日曜まず空いてます。
flagged.why: Bare time noun + まず ('almost certainly') is natural: 'Next Sunday I'm pretty much certainly free' -> second key.

flagged.filled_sentence: 明日の朝まず空いています。
flagged.why: Same pattern as 3855: bare time noun + まず ('almost certainly') + 空いています is natural -> second key.

flagged.filled_sentence: 母らはチェスをしています。
flagged.why: 母ら (mother and others) is grammatical and used in written Japanese; the sentence is a plausible second key.

flagged.filled_sentence: 集まりはのんびりしています。
flagged.why: のんびりしている can describe the atmosphere of a gathering ('the get-together is laid-back'); grammatical and plausible.

flagged.filled_sentence: 暗くなってからは予約するな。
flagged.why: 予約する is a valid suru-verb; the sentence is grammatical and a native could accept it (odd but not wrong), so it risks a second key.

flagged.filled_sentence: あの兄ももう上がったりだ。
flagged.why: あの兄 (that brother of his) is grammatical and fits the stem as naturally as あの男; 友 (あの友も…) is also marginally possible in literary register.

flagged.filled_sentence: このあたりにはそんな経験の人は一人もいない。
flagged.why: そんな経験の人 ('a person with that kind of experience') is understandable and borderline-acceptable; strict rule says flag when in doubt.

flagged.filled_sentence: 横切る月もでてきました。
flagged.why: Key itself is doubtful: 新しい月 for a visible moon is odd (the new moon is 新月 and not visible; 新しい月 reads as 'new month'). The relative clause 横切る月 is grammatical, so the key has no clear edge over it.

flagged.filled_sentence: チェスを一番どうですか。
flagged.why: Key relies on the rare counter sense of 一番 ('one game/bout'); a learner reads 一番 as 'the most', so the stem is opaque and the key reads as unnatural at N3.

flagged.filled_sentence: 毎晩会合するよ。
flagged.why: 会合する is a valid suru-verb ('to meet, assemble'); 'We meet every night' is grammatical and plausible.

flagged.filled_sentence: 客がどすんと音を立てて倒れるのが聞こえた。
flagged.why: A guest/customer falling down with a thud is perfectly natural; second key.

flagged.filled_sentence: 彼女は５日にピアノをひきだした。
flagged.why: 'She started playing the piano on the 5th' is grammatical and natural; second key.

flagged.filled_sentence: 夫婦はさびしい生活を送った。
flagged.why: 'The couple led a lonely life' is fully natural; 後者 ('the latter') also yields a grammatical sentence.

flagged.filled_sentence: 君が着るのももっともだ。
flagged.why: Elliptical like the key itself (object dropped): 'It's reasonable that you'd wear it too' is grammatical; stem has no context excluding it.

flagged.filled_sentence: 今度は母さんを連れていらっしゃい。
flagged.why: 母さん is a standard word; 'Next time bring your mother' is natural; second key.

flagged.filled_sentence: その空港は十分に利用された。
flagged.why: 'That airport was well utilized' is grammatical and natural; second key.

flagged.filled_sentence: 役は、注意深く選ばなければなりません。
flagged.why: 'Roles must be chosen carefully' (e.g. casting) is natural; second key.

flagged.filled_sentence: 最も強い城でさえ台風を止める事はできない。
flagged.why: 'Even the strongest castle can't stop a typhoon' is grammatical and interpretable; borderline but strictness applies.

flagged.filled_sentence: 兄は決してうそは申しません。
flagged.why: Humble 申す is correct for an in-group family member speaking to outsiders; 'My brother never lies' is natural; second key.

flagged.filled_sentence: 都の思い出が急に心に浮かんだ。
flagged.why: 'Memories of the capital suddenly came to mind' is grammatical (literary register); borderline second key.

flagged.filled_sentence: 宅の祖父も祖母も亡くなっている。
flagged.why: 宅 is a (dated, humble) word for 'my household/my husband'; '宅の祖父も祖母も' is grammatical; borderline second key.

flagged.filled_sentence: うん。もちろん、下げるよ。
flagged.why: Natural reply ('Sure, of course I'll lower it'); the stem has no context pinning 手伝う. 高校生よ ('of course I'm a high schooler', feminine speech) is also acceptable.

flagged.filled_sentence: すばらしい食事を経験下さい。
flagged.why: The key is unnatural: bare 経験下さい (no ご or して) is ungrammatical. It needs ご経験下さい or 経験して下さい, so the stem looks truncated (ご missing).

flagged.filled_sentence: われわれはきっと老いに勝てると考えていた。
flagged.why: 老いに勝つ ('beat aging') is a real collocation, so this is a correct and natural sentence.

flagged.filled_sentence: 母のガソリンスタンドに寄ろうよ。
flagged.why: Correct and natural: 'Let's stop at mom's gas station.' The possessive の phrase is fine with no context.

flagged.filled_sentence: 毎朝してもよろしいですか。
flagged.why: A natural polite request ('May I do it every morning?'). 毎朝 works as an adverb before する.

flagged.filled_sentence: もうそろそろ入場しなくては。
flagged.why: Natural: 'We have to go in (to the venue) soon.' 入場する is a する-verb.

flagged.filled_sentence: 力いっぱい女をたたいた。
flagged.why: Correct and natural: 'hit the woman with all my strength'. 女 (woman) is a valid object.

flagged.filled_sentence: ご飯も遊びも大事だ。
flagged.why: Natural: 'Both meals and play are important' (a common thing to say about children).

flagged.filled_sentence: 小鳥たちが森の木でさえずっていた。
flagged.why: Birds chirping in the forest's trees is fully natural; second key.

flagged.filled_sentence: 正午からオーバーを着てもかまいません。
flagged.why: Grammatical and interpretable (you may wear the overcoat starting at noon); strict flag.

flagged.filled_sentence: 私は近所の友と楽しい会話をしました。
flagged.why: 近所の友 (a friend from the neighborhood) is acceptable, slightly literary; second key.

flagged.filled_sentence: はっきりわかる方向はなかった。
flagged.why: There was no clearly discernible direction: grammatical and plausible; strict flag.

flagged.filled_sentence: 知事は娘のためにパソコンを買ってやった。
flagged.why: The governor bought his daughter a computer: fully natural; second key.

flagged.filled_sentence: そのスーツは姉によく合います。
flagged.why: The suit suits my older sister: fully natural; second key.

flagged.filled_sentence: 英語は世代から世代へと伝えられる。
flagged.why: A language being passed down across generations is grammatical and semantically plausible; strict flag.

flagged.filled_sentence: 乗り物に戻りなさい。
flagged.why: Go back to the vehicle: grammatical and usable in context (tour, ride); strict flag.

flagged.filled_sentence: 彼らはそのけんかをやめさせた。
flagged.why: They stopped the fight: fully natural; second key.

flagged.filled_sentence: 少年は母親のハンドバッグから切手を盗んだ。
flagged.why: Stealing stamps from the handbag is fully natural; second key.

flagged.filled_sentence: その意思は世代から世代へと伝えられた。
flagged.why: A will/intention handed down through generations is acceptable; strict flag.

flagged.filled_sentence: あの娘何学部だっけ？
flagged.why: あの娘 (that girl) is a natural colloquial subject; second key.

flagged.filled_sentence: 建物でエスカレーターがありません。
flagged.why: Key itself unnatural: existence with ありません takes に/には (建物にはエスカレーターがありません), not で.

flagged.filled_sentence: 皆は中学校に入った。
flagged.why: Everyone entered middle school: grammatical and acceptable; strict flag.

flagged.filled_sentence: 男はデパートでオーバーをあつらえた。
flagged.why: The man had an overcoat made at a department store: natural narrative sentence; second key.

flagged.filled_sentence: 着物のしたにセーターを着た方がよい。
flagged.why: Wearing a sweater under a kimono is grammatical and plausible advice in cold weather; strict flag.

flagged.filled_sentence: 先生は女優みんなを名前で呼んだ。
flagged.why: 女優みんなを名前で呼んだ: grammatical appositive (like 生徒みんな) and meaningful (a teacher calling all the actresses by name); plausible second key.

flagged.filled_sentence: その船はあそこで右に曲がった。
flagged.why: A ship turning right there is natural and correct; second key.

flagged.filled_sentence: 飛行機は山の側を飛んだ。
flagged.why: 山の側(そば)を飛んだ 'flew alongside the mountain' is natural; second key.

flagged.filled_sentence: 小さな子供たちを任せるのはやさしくない。
flagged.why: Entrusting small children (to someone) is not easy: natural with elided に-phrase; plausible second key.

flagged.filled_sentence: バスが止まるまで答えるな。
flagged.why: Don't answer until the bus stops: grammatical prohibitive, contextually unusual but acceptable; strict flag.

flagged.filled_sentence: 私には夏休みの友達が２人います。
flagged.why: Friends from summer vacation: 夏休みの友達 is a plausible natural phrase; strict flag.

flagged.filled_sentence: なぜなら彼らはちょうどテレビを見ている。
flagged.why: Key itself is unnatural: なぜなら with no closing からだ/から (source sentence has no reason clause ending); stem reads as ungrammatical.

flagged.filled_sentence: 彼は話そうとするところだった。
flagged.why: Key awkward: natives say 話そうとしているところだった or 話すところだった; plain-form 話そうとするところだった reads unnatural.

flagged.filled_sentence: 私は西に対して東側にいます。
flagged.why: Key sentence semantically odd/unnatural (being on the east side 'relative to west'); not something a native would say.

flagged.filled_sentence: 私は東に対して西側にいます。
flagged.why: Key sentence semantically odd/unnatural; same Tatoeba oddity as 5087.

flagged.filled_sentence: 私は北に対して西側にいます。
flagged.why: Key sentence nonsensical (west side relative to north); unnatural.

flagged.filled_sentence: というより仕事を失うことになるかもしれない。
flagged.why: Sentence-initial colloquial というより ('rather, ...') is a natural reply-opener; stem gives no context excluding it -> second key.

flagged.filled_sentence: 友達でもないわけだ。
flagged.why: 友達でもないわけだ = 'so (you're) not even a friend, then' - a grammatical, natural conclusion sentence (plain negative + わけだ), a second key.

flagged.filled_sentence: 彼女は２０歳というのは通用する。
flagged.why: Readable as 'claiming she is 20 would pass/be believable' (a claim as subject of 通用する, like その言い訳は通用しない). Slightly marked with は, but plausible; strict rule: flag.

flagged.filled_sentence: 大学生はのんびりしています。
flagged.why: 'College students are laid-back' is a natural standalone sentence.

flagged.filled_sentence: 近所を出てから10年になります。
flagged.why: 'Ten years since I left the neighborhood' is grammatical and plausible on its own.

flagged.filled_sentence: 明後日クラスはいかがですか。
flagged.why: Readable as 'how about a class the day after tomorrow?' (time noun without particle, colloquially fine).

flagged.filled_sentence: 水曜日上着を着ている。
flagged.why: Time noun without particle reads as 'wears a jacket on Wednesdays'; 木曜日 yields the same second key.

flagged.filled_sentence: 休みはむしろ外出したくない。
flagged.why: 'On days off I would rather not go out' is fully natural.

flagged.filled_sentence: ここから林までどのくらい遠いのでしょうか。
flagged.why: Asking the distance to a grove/woods is grammatical and natural; the stem gives no cue that forces 海.

flagged.filled_sentence: 時計が止まって、何時がわからなくなった。
flagged.why: Borderline: standard form is 何時かわからない, but colloquial 何時がわからない is heard and a learner could defend it; in doubt, flag.

flagged.filled_sentence: 下まではわずか半マイルだ。
flagged.why: 'It is only half a mile to the bottom' (e.g. descending a hill) is a natural sentence; nothing in the stem rules it out.

flagged.filled_sentence: 車が悪いのでスピードを出せない。
flagged.why: 'The car is in bad shape so I can't go fast' is natural; 車 is as valid as 道 from the stem alone.

flagged.filled_sentence: 犬は来月のはじめに帰ってきます。
flagged.why: A dog returning from boarding/training early next month is grammatical and plausible; in doubt, flag.

flagged.filled_sentence: 車が出てきました。
flagged.why: 'A car came out/appeared' is fully natural; the stem has no context forcing 風.

flagged.filled_sentence: 山の川でクマを見たことはありますか？
flagged.why: Seeing a bear at a mountain river (also 山の池, a mountain pond) is natural; two distractors yield valid sentences.

flagged.filled_sentence: 木の間に何が見える。
flagged.why: Reads as a natural question ('What can you see between the trees?'); Japanese questions may end in 。, so 何 is defensible.

flagged.filled_sentence: 駅で電話します。
flagged.why: 'I'll call from the station' is fully natural; the stem has no context forcing 後で.

flagged.filled_sentence: 動物の力だけでそれをできる。
flagged.why: 'It can be done with animal power alone' (e.g. draft animals) is grammatical and meaningful; in doubt, flag.

flagged.filled_sentence: おれの地図のとおりではないか。
flagged.why: 'Isn't it just as my map shows?' is grammatical and natural; Nのとおり is standard, so 地図 competes with 言う.

flagged.filled_sentence: 病気で動かれなくなったのではないかな。
flagged.why: 動かれなくなった is a nonstandard/dialectal potential (standard: 動けなくなった), so the keyed sentence is not a clean model; also 入院で動け(かれ)なくなった is arguably a second key.

flagged.filled_sentence: 朝は歌いたい気がする。
flagged.why: 'In the morning I feel like singing' is natural (秋は… 'in autumn' also works); topic は on a time word is ordinary.

flagged.filled_sentence: 特急の質は下がりつつある。
flagged.why: 'The quality of limited-express service is declining' is grammatical and plausible; in doubt, flag.

flagged.filled_sentence: 私はいつもだいたい早く起きた。
flagged.why: いつもだいたい早く起きた ("I always generally got up early") is grammatical and natural as a habitual past; second key.

flagged.filled_sentence: 世に真の交際なし。
flagged.why: 'No true friendship in the world' reads as a natural aphorism (存在 also works philosophically); the key 真の大事 is itself an odd collocation. Strict flag.

flagged.filled_sentence: 作業なら、すぐにまいりましょう。
flagged.why: 'If it's for the work, I'll come right away' is grammatical and plausible as a reply; strict flag.

flagged.filled_sentence: 土曜日動物が動物園から逃げた。
flagged.why: Day-of-week as a bare time adverb ('On Saturday an animal escaped from the zoo') is accepted in casual Japanese; strict flag.

flagged.filled_sentence: クラブの会員は２０日に集まった。
flagged.why: 'The club members gathered on the 20th' is fully natural; clear second key (何処か also works: 'gathered somewhere').

flagged.filled_sentence: さあっと、書類を済ませますか。
flagged.why: 'Shall we get the paperwork done?' is loosely acceptable in speech; strict flag.

flagged.filled_sentence: ご主人が石を投げる。
flagged.why: 'The husband/master throws a stone' is grammatical and natural on its own; second key.

flagged.filled_sentence: 王に石を投げるな。
flagged.why: 'Don't throw stones at the king' is fully natural; second key.

flagged.filled_sentence: 係は何でも意のままに行うことが出来た。
flagged.why: 係 alone can denote the person in charge; 'the person in charge could do anything at will' is grammatical and plausible. Strict flag.

flagged.filled_sentence: いつ音楽を変えたのですか。
flagged.why: 'When did you change the music?' is fully natural (予報 also grammatical); second key.

flagged.filled_sentence: 決めるのは夫でなくて構いませんよ。
flagged.why: 'It doesn't have to be your husband who decides' is fully natural; second key.

flagged.filled_sentence: パパ夜中に行ってもいい？
flagged.why: 'Dad, can I go in the middle of the night?' is fully natural; second key.

flagged.filled_sentence: 内は歯医者で歯を調べてもらった。
flagged.why: 内 read as うち ('I / our family') gives a grammatical sentence; kanji spelling is unusual but a native could accept it. Strict flag.

flagged.filled_sentence: 宿が料金を払わなかったので水道を止められた。
flagged.why: 'The inn didn't pay its bill, so its water was cut off' is grammatical and plausible; second key.

flagged.filled_sentence: 選ぶべき案は自由か死だ。
flagged.why: 'The option to choose is freedom or death' is grammatical and acceptable; strict flag.

@@ -222,7 +226,7 @@ def slot_shape(ms, at: int) -> frozenset[str]:
